agent_answered.text: "A payment can be confirmed on the ledger while the buyer's client never learns it was; the retry then produces a second transfer of the exact quoted amount. So the test I would want is: same quote, two sends of the exact amount inside the window, one call delivered, and a deterministic answer about what happens to the second ... is the lookup keyed by something the buyer holds before it pays rather than by a transaction hash it may not have observed." [e76b17d0-6258-4a6b-95b5-676540622e04]
